statement: Linux Gen 1 and Gen 2 module tables share buttons, rumble, battery, LEDs, accelerometer and IR; Gen 2 adds builtin MP policy. This supports a reusable consumer base implementation, not bit-identical physical HID descriptors, report set, EEPROM, speaker, IR behavior or LED/battery timing. Reverse engineering references describe TR using a different Bluetooth chipset/name and stricter pairing/data-channel behavior versus older controllers, which may require authentication before data-channel opening and avoid legacy control-channel SET_REPORT. Exact per-revision base HID/EEPROM differences are unverified.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux v6.12 core.c 570-605; xwiimote DEV_REMOTE 36-116, DEVICES 316-337; wiiuse README 103-112. WiiBrew current page corroborates TR Bluetooth difference but no byte-for-byte descriptor trace. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
